en: Sepia panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley with surrounding hills or low mountains. The settlement consists of clustered traditional buildings and a prominent church with a tall steeple on the right side. In the foreground are fields, orchards, and trees. A white border surrounds the image, and the caption at the bottom reads "CIVEZZANO (Trentino) - Panorama."
